description: A scrambled Rubik’s Cube sits on a green tabletop in front of you, with blank boards propped up in the background. The left hand moves in and grips the cube, then the right hand comes in so it becomes a two-hand object as both hands lift it slightly and rotate it; the thumbs and fingers make a series of quick quarter-turns, twisting the top and side layers while the cube is angled and reoriented between the hands.
